title: [MTR4] Loughborough Tube 2024 Tube Stock
description: Adds the 2024 tube stock in Loughborough livery to MTR
body:
This pack is made by Skywalker_6517 and commissioned by 96_stk for the Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR) version 4.x 

The pack adds the Loughborough Tube 2024 stock. The train runs in 9 cars, with 3 major coach types.

The pack adds these coaches:
- Cab forwards
- Trailer short (no underside bogie)
- Trailer standard
- Cab backwards

The recommended consist is to have the short coaches between other coaches to create the levitating effect on the real train. If you would like to use the original version, click here:

[London Underground 2024 stock](https://www.patreon.com/posts/2024-stock-159540447?source=storefront) (new with displays and decals)

[London Underground 2024 Stock](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/london-underground-piccadilly-line-2024-tube-stock) (old without displays and decals)

This pack is not to be altered in any way unless permission is given directly in the discord server.
